title: Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo Ku-X (Twitter) Kalula
description: Indlela yokulanda amavidiyo ku-X (Twitter) efonini noma ku-laptop ngaphandle kwe-app nokungena. Kopisha ilinki, uyinamathisele ku-I Need Save, ukhethe.
body:
I-X, phambilini eyayibizwa ngokuthi i-Twitter, ivamise ukuba yindawo yokuqala lapho amavidiyo asakazeka khona: iziqeshana zezindaba, izikhathi zezemidlalo, kuya kuma-meme wonke umuntu akhuluma ngawo. Inkinga wukuthi ukulondoloza leyo vidiyo ku-gallery akulula ngaso sonke isikhathi njengokucindezela inkinobho eyodwa. Ungakhathazeki, ungalanda amavidiyo ku-X (Twitter) kalula nge-I Need Save. Mahhala, ngaphandle kwe-app, nangaphandle kokungena ngemvume.

Lo mhlahlandlela uchaza izinyathelo efonini nakukhompyutha, izinketho zamafayela ezikhona, nezixazululo uma ukulanda kwehluleka.

Ngaphambi Kokuqala

Qiniseka ukuthi ividiyo ofuna ukuyilondoloza ivela kokuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni. Okuthunyelwe okuvela kuma-akhawunti akhiyiwe, okuqukethwe okubonakala kuphela ngemuva kokungena ngemvume, noma okukhawulelwe ezifundeni ezithile akukwazi ukulandwa.

Akudingeki futhi unikeze ukufinyelela ku-akhawunti yakho ye-X. I-I Need Save idinga kuphela ilinki yokuthunyelwe.

Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo Ku-X (Twitter) Efonini

Lezi zinyathelo zisebenza ku-Android naku-iPhone:

  1. Vula i-app ye-X bese ufuna okuthunyelwe okunevidiyo ofuna ukuyilondoloza.
  2. Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana (Share) kulokho okuthunyelwe.
  3. Khetha Kopisha ilinki (Copy link).
  4. Vula i-browser bese uvakashela i-ineedsave.com.
  5. Namathisela ilinki ebhokisini elikhona, noma uthephe inkinobho ethi Namathisela.
  6. Cindezela okuthi Landa bese ulinda kuvele izinketho zamafayela.
  7. Khetha ikhwalithi yevidiyo oyifunayo, bese ukulanda kuzoqala.

Kwesinye isikhathi inkinobho ibonisa okuthi Iyalungisa…. Kusho ukuthi ividiyo iqala icutshungulwe, isibonelo i-stream iguqulelwa ku-MP4 noma ividiyo nomsindo wayo kuyahlanganiswa. Shiya ikhasi livuliwe, futhi ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ifayela selilungile.

Indlela Yokulanda Amavidiyo e-X ku-Laptop Noma ku-PC

Uma uvula i-X ku-browser yekhompyutha, indlela nayo ilula ngokufanayo:

  1. Vula okuthunyelwe okunevidiyo.
  2. Kopisha ilinki yalokho okuthunyelwe kumenyu ethi Yabelana noma ku-address bar.
  3. Vula ikhasi lokulanda kuthebhu entsha bese unamathisela ilinki.
  4. Chofoza okuthi Landa, bese ukhetha inketho oyifunayo.

Ifayela lizolondolozwa kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe) kukhompyutha.

Izinketho Ozozibona

Ngemuva kokuthi ilinki icutshunguliwe, i-I Need Save ibonisa izinketho ngokuya ngokuthunyelwe kwangempela. Ngokuvamile uzothola:

  • Ividiyo ngamakhwalithi ahlukene, isibonelo 360p, 720p, noma 1080p. Ama-resolution akhona ancike kuvidiyo eyalayishwa.
  • Umsindo, kungaba ngekhwalithi yangempela noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe evidiyweni.
  • Isithombe / Isithonjana sokuthunyelwe.

Inketho yomsindo iwusizo uma okudingayo kuyizwi kuphela, isibonelo ingxenye yengxoxo noma umculo. Ungafunda izinyathelo eziphelele endatshaneni ethi indlela yokuguqula amavidiyo ezinkundla zokuxhumana abe yi-MP3.

Ithiphu: Uma ufuna nje ukuphinda uyibuke efonini, i-720p ivamise ukucaca ngokwanele futhi idla indawo yokugcina encane kune-1080p.

Kungani Usebenzisa i-I Need Save?

Kunezinto ezimbalwa ezenza le ndlela ibe lula ukuyisebenzisa nsuku zonke:

  • Ayikho i-app. Konke kusebenza ku-browser, ngakho indawo yokugcina yefoni ayisetshenziswa i-app eyengeziwe.
  • Akukho ukungena ngemvume. Akudingeki uvule i-akhawunti noma uxhumanise i-akhawunti yakho ye-X.
  • Akuyona i-X kuphela. Le ndlela efanayo ingasetshenziswa ku-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, nakwezinye izinkundla ezisekelwayo.
  • Kumnandi ukuyisebenzisa. Isayithi litholakala ngezilimi ezingu-93 futhi lilandela itimu ekhanyayo noma emnyama yedivayisi yakho.

Indawo Yefayela Ngemuva Kokulanda

  • I-Android nekhompyutha: ifayela lingena kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ku-Android, i-app ye-Gallery kwesinye isikhathi idinga isikhashana ngaphambi kokulibonisa.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): ifayela lingena ku-app ethi Files, kufolda ethi Downloads (Okulandiwe). Ukuze ulidlulisele ku-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo ku-Files, thepha okuthi Share (Yabelana), bese ukhetha Save Video (Londoloza Ividiyo).

Amavidiyo e-MP4 alandiwe anobude besikhathi obulungile futhi adlala kuma-app e-gallery. Amafayela futhi adluliswa ngqo esuka ku-X aye kudivayisi yakho, ngaphandle kokugcinwa kuseva ye-I Need Save.

Uma Ukulanda Kwehluleka

Nazi ezinye zezizathu ezivame kakhulu:

  • I-akhawunti ikhiyiwe. Amavidiyo avela kuma-akhawunti ayimfihlo awakwazi ukuthathwa.
  • Kudinga ukungena ngemvume. Okuqukethwe okubonakala kuphela ngemuva kokungena ku-akhawunti nakho akukwazi ukulandwa.
  • Imikhawulo yesifunda. Amavidiyo akhawulelwe emazweni athile awatholakali.
  • Ilinki engalungile. Qiniseka ukuthi okukopishile kuyilinki yokuthunyelwe, hhayi ilinki yephrofayela. Yikopishe futhi enkinobhweni ethi Yabelana.

Ungakhohlwa Imigomo Yokuziphatha

Londoloza amavidiyo ukuze uwasebenzise wena kuphela. Uma ufuna ukuwaphinda wabelane ngawo kwenye inkundla, cela imvume kumdali futhi ubalule igama lakhe. Ukuhlonipha amalungelo obunikazi kugcina abadali bekhuthele ukwakha. Funda nendatshana ethi imigomo yokuziphatha namalungelo obunikazi lapho ulanda okuqukethwe ukuze uthole incazelo ephelele.

Imibuzo Evame Ukubuzwa

Ingabe i-I Need Save ingasetshenziswa ku-iPhone?

Yebo. Vula i-ineedsave.com ku-Safari, landela izinyathelo ezifanayo, bese uthola ividiyo ku-app ethi Files.

Ngidinga ukungena ku-akhawunti yami ye-X?

Cha. Vele unamathisele ilinki yokuthunyelwe okusesidlangalaleni, ngaphandle kokungena ngemvume nangaphandle kokuvula i-akhawunti.

Kungani inkinobho ibonisa okuthi Iyalungisa…?

Leyo vidiyo iyacutshungulwa, isibonelo i-stream iguqulelwa ku-MP4. Ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma sekuqediwe.
